rules: Unknown capability IDs fail closed and require a versioned extension, never fallback to a similar ID.
Availability and applicable calibration are rechecked at execution.
Result success describes operation completion; measurement pass requires a separate criteria evaluation.
Missing measurement fields remain unknown, never zero or a model-created number.
A capability enum entry is not evidence of ownership, qualification, implementation or permission.
Manual observations require the actual instrument and named operator; driver output and AI interpretations retain distinct provenance.
Robot execution and fiber workflows remain halo in revision 1.3.
Physical actuation requires a qualified adapter, interlocks, emergency stop and separately approved physical scope before execution.
